_comment: WhatsApp credits, one wallet per Meta pricing category (owner decision 2026-11-12). 1 credit = 1 message. A send spends only from its own category. Prices are KES per message and never below 1. Changing a price or a bundle size here is a release; units already bought are kept.

categories.name: Promotions and broadcasts
categories.explainer: Messages you send to many customers at once to promote your business: holiday and occasion greetings, offers and broadcast announcements.

categories.name: Order, payment and account updates
categories.explainer: Messages about something a customer did or asked for: order confirmations and delivery updates, receipts, invoices, payment reminders, bookings and account notices.

categories.name: Login and verification codes
categories.explainer: One-time codes that let a person sign in, confirm their phone number or reset a password.

categories.name: Replies to customers
categories.explainer: Messages you or your assistant type in reply to a customer who wrote to you in the last 24 hours, such as answers sent from the WhatsApp inbox.
